title: WaterColor 150 Cove Hollow Street
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: -Per WaterColor HOA, all guests 5 years of age or older must be included in your adult guest total in order to receive wristbands to access amenities and pools. This home is allotted 10 wristbands.- Located in WaterColor's Lake District- Private pool **Pool heating available Oct 1–May 1 for $45 per day**- Minutes from Frog Pool- Professionally decorated- Indoor/outdoor fireplace- Ping-pong table- Parking for 4 vehicles- Low-Speed Vehicle- 3 adult bikes - Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutGuests staying in WaterColor will have access to the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club. It features a new main pool and lounge area, second pool deck with additional lounge seating, and third pool with zero-entry, as well an enhanced WaterColor Grill, and new sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico.DETAILS: Now and then, you come across a vacation home that speaks to you. It's easy to picture friends and family lounging around the private pool. You can see them relaxing in the evening before the indoor/outdoor fireplace on cushioned chairs, sharing stories, and planning the next days' adventures. So it is with this WaterColor retreat at 150 Cove Hollow Street - a 3-bedroom, 3-bathroom with 2 half baths, 30A getaway. The outdoor spaces are simply magical, while the interior delights. Professional decor incorporates beautiful hardwood floors and window and door transoms, allowing for abundant natural light. The chef's kitchen features granite countertops, designer cabinets, and select stainless appliances, including a gas range. An open design concept and island counter keep the chef at the center of the conversation during meal preparation. The dining area offers table seating for 8 while the counter has seating for 5 more guests. The living area features a gas fireplace, sprawling sectional sofa, and a vast flat-screen television, making it the perfect space for loved ones to gather for movie night. Situated on the first floor is the primary bedroom with a private bathroom and shower only. Ascending the stairs to the second floor, you'll find two guest bedrooms, both with king beds - one with a private bathroom with a shower, the other with a shared bathroom and shower/tub combo. Adjacent is the bunk area with 2 twin-over-twin bunk beds. The additional living space on the second floor also offers 2 twin beds. This WaterColor home comfortably sleeps 10 guests.If the private pool is the home's focal point, the indoor/outdoor gas fireplace is its soul. This home is also all about fun, with a game room, complete with a ping-pong table in the upstairs living space. All of the dining and shopping possibilities are within easy walking distance - or a fun ride away on the golf cart.SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: FIRST FLOOR- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlySECOND FLOOR- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Bunk Area: Two Twin-over-Twin Bunk Beds- Additional Living: Two Twin BedsWeddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments and be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.
